name: Forest Dwellers
summary:
You are a monkey. And this type of monkey doesn't depend on it's legs but instead it uses it's arms. It has been billions of years since monkey's have had legs, but now they rule the world and humanity really has been rejected.
Be apart of the Forest Dwellers, be one with monke.

Features

-Multiplayer
-You can jump on trees
-There's a cool shop
-You are a monkey
